experiment: Paired Joint v1 vs Autonomous Consistency v3 training-seed replication

verification_evidence.full_suite_fixture: Read-only missing legacy helper/report blobs from Git8879754a43302e9c55b27de4ce3c629c7e4e1a53; local-only harness, no historical algorithm files restored or merged.
skips: Three historical Recurrent-source-worktree tests; no new algorithm test skipped

scientific_interpretation.scope: Five paired joint-training seeds from one fixed upstream pretrained initialization; not random-initialization or full end-to-end replication.
scientific_interpretation.long_horizon_result: Preliminary support: v3 improves H25 and H50 in 5/5 paired seeds; mean per-pair H50 improvement 42.352584 percent. No failed, replaced or collapsed seeds.
scientific_interpretation.short_horizon_tradeoff: v3 worsens H1/H5/H10 in 5/5 seeds, by approximately 0.27 to 1.82 percent depending on horizon/seed; it is not overall dominant at all horizons.
scientific_interpretation.reconstruction: v3 current reconstruction improves slightly in all five pairs; no systematic severe representation sacrifice observed.
scientific_interpretation.correction: Never-C1 and never-C10 diagnostic gaps shrink in all five pairs; real-history corrections remain diagnostic, not autonomous deployment.
scientific_interpretation.current_baseline: Autonomous Consistency v3 formulation; retain original seed0 reference checkpoint, not the Test-best seed.
scientific_interpretation.single_next_recommendation_not_executed: Paired end-to-end replication across independently pretrained upstream initializations.
scientific_interpretation.limits: Descriptive n=5 fixed-initialization evidence, nominal simulation, recorded actions, overlapping windows; no significance, unique-root-cause or general end-to-end robustness claim.

replication_type: joint-training seed replication from ONE fixed pretrained initialization; NOT random initialization or end-to-end pipeline replication

initialization.conversion: one-time affine folding into T/D weights; no runtime latent normalization

initial_function_equivalence.probe_rule: fixed linspace rawz[-1,1] 8x64 and normalized action[-1,1] 8x4; no Test selection

generation_config.input_convention: pre-command obs7 + previous executed normalized action4

dataset.transition_rule: o_t=inputs[t,:7], a_t=actions[t], next=inputs[t+1,:7]; within episode only
dataset.previous_action_rule: inputs[t,7:11] = executed normalized action at t-1; reset=0

initial_latent_scale.rule: initial Encoder real-history population std; fixed throughout training, difference loss has no mean subtraction

windows.protocol: all starts t in range(max(0,N-H+1)), per episode
